ai.summary: A new host allowlist, `AD_PLATFORM_IMAGE_HOSTS`, and a validation helper, `promotedPostImageUrl`, were added to `common/src/constants/freebuff-ads.ts` to sanitize `preview_image_url` values for advertiser promoted posts. The helper returns a URL only if it is HTTPS, free of credentials or ports, and hosted on the exact image CDN of the post's platform, such as `pbs.twimg.com` for Twitter or `opengraph.githubassets.com` for GitHub. This prevents the Earn feed from rendering third-party tracking pixels or same-origin requests that would leak viewer IP addresses and session cookies. The change includes unit tests that verify the helper rejects cross-platform CDNs, subdomain suffix tricks, and non-HTTPS schemes.
